rules.css: header { height: var(--nav-height); }
header .header, footer .footer { visibility: hidden; }
header .header[data-block-status="loaded"], footer .footer[data-block-status="loaded"] { visibility: visible; }
h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 { margin-top: 0.8em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; font-family: var(--heading-font-family); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.25; scroll-margin: 40px; }
h1 { margin: 0px 0px 16px; font-size: var(--heading-font-size-xxl); font-family: var(--display-font-family); font-weight: 400; line-height: 34px; color: var(--dark-color); }

rules.selector: p, dl, ol, ul, pre, blockquote
rules.css: p, dl, ol, ul, pre, blockquote { margin-top: 0.8em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; }
main > div { margin: 40px 16px; }
input, textarea, select, button { font: inherit; }
a:any-link { color: var(--link-color); text-decoration: none; overflow-wrap: break-word; }
a:hover { color: var(--link-hover-color); text-decoration: underline; }
main img { max-width: 100%; width: auto; height: auto; }
main > .section { margin: 20px 0px; }
main > .section > div { max-width: var(--content-max-width); margin: auto; padding: 0 var(--content-gutter); }
main > .section:first-of-type { margin-top: 0px; }
main > .section.content-column > div { box-sizing: border-box; padding: 25px 25px 25px 14px; font-family: verdana, arial, sans-serif; }
main .section.content-column .default-content-wrapper > * { width: 75%; margin-left: auto; }

main .section.content-column h1, main .section.content-column h2 { margin: 0px 0px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(204, 204, 204); color: var(--dark-color); font-family: var(--display-font-family); font-size: 24px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 30px; }
main .section.content-column .default-content-wrapper > * { width: 100%; }
.hero-container .hero-wrapper { max-width: unset; padding: 0px; }
.hero { position: relative; padding: 40px 24px; min-height: 300px; }
.hero picture { position: absolute; z-index: -1; inset: 0px; object-fit: cover; box-sizing: border-box; }
.hero img { object-fit: cover; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.hero { padding: 40px 32px; }
.hero.panel .hero-panel { box-sizing: border-box; background-color: var(--panel-color); padding: 20px 15px; color: var(--background-color); }
.hero.panel .hero-panel > div { padding: 0px 40px; }
.hero.panel .hero-panel p { margin: 0px 0px 25px; font-size: var(--heading-font-size-s); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--background-color); }
.hero.panel .hero-panel ul { margin: 0px; padding: 0px; list-style: none; }
.hero.panel .hero-panel li + li { margin-top: 16px; }

.hero.panel .hero-panel a:any-link { display: block; background-color: var(--brand-navy); color: var(--background-color); font-family: var(--display-font-family); font-size: var(--heading-font-size-l); line-height: 37px; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; }
.hero.panel .hero-panel a:hover { background-color: var(--link-hover-color); text-decoration: none; }
.hero.panel .hero-image { line-height: 0; }
.hero.panel picture { position: static; display: block; }
.hero.panel img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; aspect-ratio: 709 / 215; object-fit: cover; }
.hero.panel { flex-direction: row; align-items: stretch; padding: 0px; }
.hero.panel .hero-panel { flex: 0 0 25%; padding: 20px 4px 20px 15px; }
.hero.panel .hero-image { flex: 1 1 0px; min-width: 0px; }
.hero.panel img { height: 100%; aspect-ratio: auto; min-height: 215px; }
header .nav-wrapper { background-color: var(--background-color); width: 100%; z-index: 2; position: fixed; }

header nav { box-sizing: border-box; display: grid; grid-template: "brand tools hamburger" "sections sections sections" 1fr / 1fr auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 0px; margin: auto; max-width: var(--content-max-width); height: var(--nav-height); padding: 0 var(--content-gutter); font-family: var(--body-font-family); }
header .nav-wrapper { position: relative; }
header nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; justify-content: flex-start; gap: 12px; max-width: var(--content-max-width); padding: 26px var(--content-gutter) 0; }
header nav .nav-brand, header nav .nav-sections { flex: 0 0 auto; }
header nav[aria-expanded="true"] { min-height: 0px; overflow: visible; }
header nav p { margin: 0px; line-height: 1; }
header nav a:any-link { color: currentcolor; }

header nav .nav-hamburger button { height: 22px; margin: 0px; border: 0px; border-radius: 0px; padding: 0px; background-color: var(--background-color); color: inherit; overflow: initial; text-overflow: initial; white-space: initial; }
header .nav-brand { grid-area: brand; flex-basis: 128px; font-size: var(--heading-font-size-s); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; }
header nav .nav-brand img { width: auto; max-width: 245px; max-height: 90px; }
header nav .nav-brand img { max-width: 100%; }
header nav .nav-sections { grid-area: sections; flex: 1 1 auto; display: none; visibility: hidden; }
header nav[aria-expanded="true"] .nav-sections { display: block; visibility: visible; align-self: start; }
header nav .nav-sections ul { list-style: none; padding-left: 0px; margin: 0px; font-size: var(--body-font-size-m); }
header nav .nav-sections ul > li { font-weight: 700; }
header nav .nav-sections ul > li > ul { margin-top: 0px; }

rules.selector: header nav .nav-sections ul > li > ul > li
rules.css: header nav .nav-sections ul > li > ul > li { font-weight: 400; }
header nav .nav-sections { display: block; visibility: visible; white-space: nowrap; }
header nav[aria-expanded="true"] .nav-sections { align-self: unset; }
header nav .nav-sections .nav-drop { position: relative; padding-right: 16px; cursor: pointer; }

header nav .nav-sections .nav-drop::after { content: ""; display: inline-block; position: absolute; top: 0.5em; right: 2px; transform: rotate(135deg); width: 6px; height: 6px; border-style: solid; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; border-radius: 0px 1px 0px 0px; border-width: 2px 2px 0px 0px; }
header nav .nav-sections ul { display: flex; gap: 24px; margin: 0px; }
header nav .nav-sections .default-content-wrapper > ul > li { flex: 0 1 auto; position: relative; }
header nav .nav-sections .default-content-wrapper > ul > li > ul { display: none; position: relative; }

header nav .nav-sections .default-content-wrapper > ul > li > ul::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -8px; left: 16px; width: 0px; height: 0px; border-left: 8px solid transparent; border-right: 8px solid transparent; border-bottom: 8px solid var(--light-color); }

rules.selector: header nav .nav-sections .default-content-wrapper > ul > li > ul > li
rules.css: header nav .nav-sections .default-content-wrapper > ul > li > ul > li { padding: 8px 0px; }
header nav .nav-sections .default-content-wrapper > ul { display: flex; justify-content: flex-start; gap: 0px; }
header nav .nav-sections .default-content-wrapper > ul > li { flex: 0 0 auto; text-align: left; padding: 7px 0px; line-height: 12px; }
header nav .nav-sections .default-content-wrapper > ul > li + li { border-left: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45); }
header nav .nav-sections a:any-link { color: var(--background-color); }
header nav .nav-sections a:hover { color: var(--background-color); text-decoration: underline; }
header nav .nav-sections .default-content-wrapper > ul > li > a { padding: 0px 40px; }
header nav .nav-sections { position: relative; margin-bottom: 30px; }
header nav .nav-sections .default-content-wrapper > ul > li.nav-active-trail { position: static; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); }

header nav .nav-sections .default-content-wrapper > ul > li.nav-active-trail > ul { display: block; box-sizing: border-box; position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 0px; width: 100%; height: 30px; padding: 0px 15px; background-color: rgb(232, 236, 244); text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; }

rules.selector: header nav .nav-sections .default-content-wrapper > ul > li.nav-active-trail > ul > li
rules.css: header nav .nav-sections .default-content-wrapper > ul > li.nav-active-trail > ul > li { display: inline-block; flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 0px; border-left-width: medium; border-left-style: none; border-left-color: currentcolor; font-weight: 400; line-height: 30px; }

rules.selector: header nav .nav-sections .default-content-wrapper > ul > li.nav-active-trail > ul a:any-link
rules.css: header nav .nav-sections .default-content-wrapper > ul > li.nav-active-trail > ul a:any-link { display: block; color: var(--link-color); padding: 0px 10px; font-size: var(--body-font-size-m); line-height: 30px; }

rules.selector: header nav .nav-sections .default-content-wrapper > ul > li.nav-active-trail > ul a:hover
rules.css: header nav .nav-sections .default-content-wrapper > ul > li.nav-active-trail > ul a:hover { color: var(--link-color); text-decoration: underline; }
header nav .nav-sections .nav-drop { padding-right: 0px; cursor: auto; }
header nav .nav-sections .nav-drop::after { content: none; }
header nav .nav-sections .default-content-wrapper > ul > li.nav-active-trail > ul { display: block; padding-left: 16px; }
footer { background-color: var(--background-color); font-size: var(--body-font-size-s); }
footer .footer > div { margin: auto; max-width: var(--content-max-width); padding: 10px var(--content-gutter) 24px; }
footer .footer .default-content-wrapper { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; }
footer .footer p { margin: 5px 0px 0px; line-height: 1.5; }
footer .footer ul { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0px 6px; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; list-style: none; }
footer .footer li + li::before { content: "|"; margin-right: 6px; color: var(--muted-color); }
footer .footer a:any-link { color: var(--link-color); }
footer .footer a:hover { color: var(--link-hover-color); text-decoration: underline; }
footer .footer .footer-copyright, footer .footer p:last-child { color: var(--muted-color); }
